_comment: Intrinsic construct parts. These ship with the package and are not
editable from the UI: a layout names them outright or resolves to them
per antibody, so losing or altering one breaks every layout at once.
Their names are reserved -- an imported parts file using one is asked to
rename. IGKC and IGLC2 are transcribed from antibody-chain-rules.md
section 5; the two CHTMCT sequences are membrane-bound heavy constant
regions (CH1 through the transmembrane and cytoplasmic tail).

IGLC2.description: Human lambda light constant region (IGLC2, the standard choice for recombinant work).

CHTMCTIgG1.description: IgG1 heavy constant region, CH1-CH3 plus the transmembrane and cytoplasmic tail.

CHTMCTIgM.description: IgM heavy constant region, CH1-CH4 plus the transmembrane and cytoplasmic tail.
